title: Structural Iron and Steel Workers
description: Raise, place, and unite iron or steel girders, columns, and other structural members to form completed structures or structural frameworks. May erect metal storage tanks and assemble prefabricated metal buildings.

tasks.text: Read specifications or blueprints to determine the locations, quantities, or sizes of materials required.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Specs reading aided, human validates requirements

dwas.name: Review blueprints or specifications to determine work requirements.

tasks.text: Verify vertical and horizontal alignment of structural steel members, using plumb bobs, laser equipment, transits, or levels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Alignment verification needs physical measurement tools

dwas.name: Verify alignment of structures or equipment.

tasks.text: Erect metal or precast concrete components for structures, such as buildings, bridges, dams, towers, storage tanks, fences, or highway guard rails.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal structural installation is hands-on

tasks.text: Bolt aligned structural steel members in position for permanent riveting, bolting, or welding into place.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal structural installation is hands-on

tasks.text: Assemble or inspect hoisting equipment or rigging, such as cables, pulleys, or hooks, to move heavy equipment or materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Erecting temporary structures requires physical assembly

tasks.text: Lift steel beams, girders, or columns using cranes or forklifts, or by signaling hoisting equipment operators to lift or position structural steel members.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.
Signal equipment operators to indicate proper equipment positioning.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Fabricate metal parts, such as steel frames, columns, beams, or girders, according to blueprints or instructions from supervisors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

tasks.text: Connect columns, beams, and girders with bolts, following blueprints and instructions from supervisors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal structural installation is hands-on

tasks.text: Pull, push, or pry structural steel members into approximate positions for bolting into place.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning structural components is physical labor

tasks.text: Unload and position prefabricated steel units for hoisting, as needed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning structural components is physical labor

dwas.name: Load or unload materials used in construction or extraction.

tasks.text: Fasten structural steel members to hoist cables, using chains, cables, or rope.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Cut, bend, or weld steel pieces, using metal shears, torches, or welding equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Welding is skilled hands-on metalwork

tasks.text: Force structural steel members into final positions, using turnbuckles, crowbars, jacks, or hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal structural installation is hands-on

tasks.text: Ride on girders or other structural steel members to position them, or use rope to guide them into position.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning structural components is physical labor

tasks.text: Drive drift pins through rivet holes to align rivet holes in structural steel members with corresponding holes in previously placed members.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal structural installation is hands-on

tasks.text: Dismantle structures or equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Dismantling structures is heavy physical labor

tasks.text: Insert sealing strips, wiring, insulating material, ladders, flanges, gauges, or valves, depending on types of structures being assembled.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical installation is hands-on licensed trade work

dwas.name: Install insulation in equipment or structures.
Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.

tasks.text: Place blocks under reinforcing bars used to reinforce floors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on positioning of safety equipment in field

tasks.text: Hold rivets while riveters use air hammers to form heads on rivets.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assisting of skilled trades on site

dwas.name: Assist skilled construction or extraction personnel.

tasks.text: Catch hot rivets in buckets and insert rivets in holes, using tongs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling construction materials is hands-on tool work
